decisions: Shared current protocol and current opendbc safety for F4/DOS and H7; downstream patch stack, no frozen legacy safety fork.
Legacy decoder/bridge only for offline or isolated observation; never transform packet versions to grant control eligibility to unknown old safety.
Keep installed bootstub unchanged. Candidate application build only; installer/reset/flash/recovery entry points separated and absent from runtime/test/build default.
No user photos/vendor documents required for offline design or candidate implementation. Unknown hardware fields remain explicit deployment gates.
Use canonical 64-byte CAN payload type on both MCUs; F4 rejects CAN FD/DLC>8 and uses smaller profile queues. H7 preserves FDCAN capabilities.

wire.byte5: XOR of header bytes0..4 and payload; XOR of full wire frame equals zero
wire.old_difference: Old packer clears fd bit and always chunks after buffer exceeds256; new fd argument sets bit0 and chunk=False is default. Both reviewed Python sources use six-byte header and XOR. Neither source proves the old MCU implementation.
wire.tx_input_contract: reject returned/rejected flags, invalid identifier/bus, bad checksum, unsupported FD/DLC before hardware TX; preserve bounded partial parsing

sound output and temperature added; temperature byte decodes as byte-40, no unavailable sentinel in baseline

bootstub_boundary.no_claim: Current reference bootstub source and historical firmware files do not prove installed bootstub identity or that new signed app can start.

modules.change: Separate app-only targets and per-MCU include/startup/linker config. Preserve explicit ALLOW_DEBUG provenance; do not reuse H7 flags on F4. Default graph currently also builds bootstub.
modules.dependency: Complete pinned F4 BSP plus toolchain lock; signing compatibility remains unproven.

modules.change: Supply clock, interrupt, ADC, PWM, USB, timer, startup, vector relocation and linker implementation. Use explicit candidate profile; unknown clock/chip/pins remain null in deployable profile.
modules.dependency: Full licensed historical F4 runtime is absent locally; select and pin complete source before implementing.

modules.change: Add DOS=6 without masquerading as H7. Map legacy initializer to new API (has_fan/LED PWM/bootkick/siren/thermal/harness), explicit feature capability. Treat DP pin table as reference only. Do not copy broad detection or infer 4 CAN controllers from 4 transceivers.
modules.dependency: Reference-only pin profile and mock GPIO; hardware verification is later deployment condition, not design prerequisite.

modules.change: Select backend by MCU; adapt bxCAN RX/TX/interrupt/errors to current CANPacket_t and current safety calls. Reject FD and DLC>8 before unsafe copy/queue. Local bus only 0..2. Preserve checksums, returned/rejected semantics and overflow counters.
modules.dependency: F4 controller/filter/mailbox definitions from chosen BSP; never reuse old safety header.

modules.change: Keep canonical new headers shared; 0xdd returns exact current two hashes. Implement health providers and capability-aware host semantics. Transport reset clears only that board/session residue. Validate TX flags/range/checksum before any backend use.
modules.dependency: Unsupported sound/temperature/FD stats need explicit absent semantics; zero is not proof of measurement. Do not change target hashes merely to accept old layouts.

modules.change: Both MCUs use locked current RX/TX/FWD/tick and local bus IDs. Only MCU internal checked forwarding may bypass TX hook. Unknown mode and missed heartbeats return SILENT. Never expose skip_tx_hook to host.
modules.dependency: Song PLUS-specific safety remains separate unimplemented work; BYD 32 to 35 is not a semantic conversion; debug BYD availability is not vehicle acceptance.

modules.change: Keep canonical 64-byte payload and hash. Configure smaller F4 queues; validate Flash/RAM/stack/DMA/interrupt budgets per declared MCU. Preserve H7 memory layout and FDCAN behavior.
modules.dependency: Physical MCU density and RAM not proven. Candidate queue count is tunable estimate, not validated capacity or throughput.

modules.change: Implement calibrated 1us timer, wrap-safe elapsed, 8Hz loop and 1Hz safety tick. Preserve threshold boundary semantics and heartbeat fail-closed behavior.
modules.dependency: Offline fake clock can prove logic, not oscillator accuracy/ISR jitter; software watchdog cannot independently detect all CPU stalls.

modules.change: Separate per-MCU application metadata and USB capability catalog from reset/flash/recover. Shared protocol does not change each board role or global bus mapping. Firmware manifest binds MCU/profile/source/signature, not merely 32-bit wire hash.
modules.dependency: Preserve installed bootstub; app USB VID may differ from existing bootstub. Host allowlist and maintenance workflow require explicit mode separation.

modules.change: Run pure ABI/codec/safety/HAL tests plus separate F4 and H7 app compile/link; never run discovery/constructor/reset/flash helpers. Record full hashes, compiler/link flags, maps, safety mode set and nondeployable status.
modules.dependency: Implementation and all compile/test execution are future work.

offline_acceptance.stimulus: Build each declared MCU app independently with locked cached toolchain; compiler warnings fail; no downloads, USB access or bootstub/install target. Produce ELF/map/bin and manifest.
offline_acceptance.pass_condition: Both targets link under explicit profiles; incomplete F4 source means not run, never a stub pass.

offline_acceptance.stimulus: Compiler static_assert sizeof health=48, CAN health=64, CANPacket=72, offsetof(data)=6, checksum=5; all non-bitfield offsets match JSON. Validate bitfields by serialized byte vectors, not offsetof(bitfield).
offline_acceptance.pass_condition: Run for F4 ARM, H7 ARM and host shims; verify wire length is 6+DLC length, never sizeof(CANPacket_t).

offline_acceptance.stimulus: Normalize CR exactly as baseline; assert health=0xffbc12f5, CAN=0x75abf276, reply f5 12 bc ff 76 f2 ab 75; mutate header/layout and verify mismatch.
offline_acceptance.pass_condition: Reject old 3-byte 10 04 05, unknown lengths and wrong hashes in target session; no fallback masquerade. Full source hashes tracked separately.

offline_acceptance.stimulus: Classic 0..8 bytes, extended and standard limits, all DLC mappings for H7; fd bit, return/reject flags, XOR. Add invalid address, local bus 3..7 and simultaneous return+reject.
offline_acceptance.pass_condition: Known vectors exact; F4 rejects fd=1 and DLC>8, even short payload. Host-origin returned/rejected frames rejected. No truncation or FD demotion.

offline_acceptance.stimulus: Split every frame at each byte and across 63/64/65-byte USB boundaries; concatenate frames and inject corrupt checksum/incomplete tails.
offline_acceptance.pass_condition: No per-64-byte counter invented; parser never emits partial/bad frame; bounded buffers; reconnect/reset drops residue. Each board has isolated state.

offline_acceptance.stimulus: Old58/new48/CANhealth64 independent fixtures; voltage/current saturation, flags, load rounding, temp offset, absent feature values.
offline_acceptance.pass_condition: Layout mismatch rejected; absence visible in capability-aware view; zero temperature byte must not be reported as a valid -40 C reading for absent sensor. Old fan stall not fabricated in new packet.

offline_acceptance.stimulus: Run current safety suite with each backend shim and same current header; RX checksum/counter/lag/frequency, TX whitelist/relay, FWD block paths, nooutput/SILENT.
offline_acceptance.pass_condition: Identical safety decisions for F4/H7 classic vectors. All applicable suite cases pass; ALLOW_DEBUG build status recorded. BYD pass never labeled Song PLUS approval.

offline_acceptance.stimulus: Trace all host TX entry points and checked forwarding; test bad checksum, unknown mode, wrong local bus, relay malfunction, unsupported format.
offline_acceptance.pass_condition: No host-controlled skip_tx_hook, ALLOUTPUT or ELM327 workaround. Rejected count/flags/checksum consistent; invalid input never reaches hardware send stub.

offline_acceptance.stimulus: Flood RX/TX, wrap producer/consumer indices, queue full/empty transitions, ISR/main interleaving model and canary memory.
offline_acceptance.pass_condition: No overwrite/use of uninitialized payload; overflow counters and backpressure observable. Test each F4/H7 queue profile, not only H7 large buffers.

offline_acceptance.stimulus: Map assertions for startup/app/vector/stack/heap/static queues, data/bss/copy tables, bank visibility and flash reserved areas.
offline_acceptance.pass_condition: Nothing overlaps bootstub, provisioning, OTP or reserved cookies; all sections in declared MCU banks; F4 contains no assumed H7 bank addresses. Size growth budget recorded.

offline_acceptance.stimulus: Fake clock advances through exact thresholds and uint32 wrap; verify 1us conversion, 8Hz tick, 1Hz safety_tick and timestamp arithmetic.
offline_acceptance.pass_condition: Threshold and wrap cases match current source; elapsed values cannot wrap into permissive safety decisions. Runtime clock accuracy remains hardware test.

offline_acceptance.stimulus: Inject tick delays at 374999,375000,375001 us; heartbeat loss on/off and engaged mismatch; IRQ starvation model.
offline_acceptance.pass_condition: Software watchdog records fault only for elapsed >375000 as current source; it does not itself set SILENT or reset. Separately verify heartbeat thresholds 5/2 enter SILENT and >=3 engaged mismatches clear controls. IRQ starvation model exposes inability to independently certify a halted CPU.

offline_acceptance.stimulus: Run declared DOS reference mode/harness/power transitions against fake GPIO, include unsupported mode and feature-off cases.
offline_acceptance.pass_condition: Pin operations match declared reference and never silently map unknown profile to H7/DOS. Physical pin correctness remains unknown; no target execution.

offline_acceptance.stimulus: Unmodified H7 fixture corpus covers CANFD, BRS, error counters, queue bank layout and original SPI/USB protocol.
offline_acceptance.pass_condition: Shared changes keep H7 FD capability and expected source behavior; no F4 restriction leaks into H7.

offline_acceptance.stimulus: Inspect existing app file format and public bootstub contract without private key/provision reads; compare entry/length/version/minimum/signature public metadata.
offline_acceptance.pass_condition: Only compatible app format eligible for later bench planning; installed bootstub trust/MCU remains unproven => deployable=false. No signature bypass or bootstub replacement.

offline_acceptance.stimulus: Audit build/test entry graph and mock imports for device APIs, subprocess flash/recovery, reset/GPIO/role writes, network downloads.
offline_acceptance.pass_condition: Offline CI cannot acquire device handles; firmware mismatch only quarantines. Build artifacts have no auto-install command.
